summary: The Backrooms is a persistent multiplayer survival RPG spanning an authored Level 0 maze, deeper levels, and shared destinations. `templates/player.js` composes player behaviors; place simulations and shared scripts own environments, NPCs, combat, loot, crafting, UI, avatar presentation, and progression. Critters are the default avatar style; players can switch the world to human bodies from the menu.
places: places/bonus (3D) - vaporwave mall with authored shops and landmarks, simulated staff/shoppers, arcade, salon, and lighting effects; people follow the world body-style setting.
places/main (3D) - authored Level 0/Lobby maze; sim generates maze furniture and loot, safe rooms, shifting walls, creature ecology, route guidance, Kade, and Zenith's sealed breach.
places/intake + places/tutorial0 (3D; tutorial0 solo ephemeral) - character creation/waking space and staged tutorial route with HALOGEN.
places/level01 (3D) - Level 0.1 Zenith Station: station/gallery, doors, breakables, bots/hazards, climate rooms, recorder quest, and drone-refilled posts.
places/level1, level2, level21 (3D) - Habitable Zone garage maze and M.E.G. camp; Pipe Dreams industrial rooms/camp/fixtures; Level 2.1 Locked.
places/level3, gamma, level4, level5 (3D) - Electrical Station, Base Gamma, Abandoned Office, and Terror Hotel; Level 4 owns office props/fixtures, residents, and hazards.
places/level6, level7, level10, level11, level12 (3D) - later levels including Level 7's drowned house and Level 11's generated city, canal/bridges, and renovation office.
places/level26, level27, debug, spamton (3D) - Level 26 quests, Level 27 Bunker Springs, debug studio, and Spamton destination.
roots: world.config.yaml + templates/player.js - multiplayer entry, player/camera setup, ordered behavior composition and keyboard/touch action mappings.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells/*.scene + sim.js - place configuration, authored placements, and local generated/ticked behavior; Level 11 entry is places/level11/sim.js tick.

scripts/main-menu.js + scripts/main-menu-ui.js + intake/tutorial scripts - title/pause, character creation, arrival, tutorial routing, first-arrival cutscene, body-style toggle, and solo pause time-scale.
places/level1/sim.js + scripts/lib/level1.js + level1 geometry scripts - seeded Level 1 ground-floor/deck generation and shared deck/ramp layout.
places/level1/cells/x0z0.scene + scripts/dina-diary.js + scripts/lib/dina-quest.js - Dina camp/diary entry and quest progression; Voss and Cabin 23/Phoebe/stow-nest interactions are in Level 26.
scripts/camera.js + scripts/view3.js + scripts/ui.js + scripts/loot-ui.js - camera, third-person toggle, HUD/panels, and inventory/equipment/quick-slot UI.
scripts/quest-marker.js + scripts/lib/quests.js + scripts/lib/quest-mark.js - per-player journal, tracking, objective resolution and markers; folds legacy quest state into shared records.
places/bonus salon + scripts/salon-ui.js - in-world makeover card; sends dress actions handled by scripts/critter.js.
shared: scripts/lib/hub.js - shared/solo room IDs, Bonus Room and home destinations/crossings, LEVEL_NAMES used by hub-ui; LEVEL_NAMES still includes absent testlab.

scripts/lib/loot.js + scripts/lib/items.js + scripts/lib/weapons.js/weapons.yml - common loot spawning, container rolls, remains, place pools, item descriptions, weapon definitions/rarity and variants.
scripts/door-geo.js + scripts/lib/door-swing.js - parametric leaf/frame/sealed-set geometry and eased hinge motion shared by built and level-specific doors.
scripts/lib/level11-vaults.js + scripts/lib/level11-depths.js + scripts/l11-crawl-geo.js + Level 11 data - security gates, crawl geometry, rooms, foe roster and storeroom.
scripts/l11-masonry.js + scripts/l11-reno.js - Level 11 canal bridge/quay/guard and renovation-office geometry; workstand can omit its procedural lamp head for a separately mounted model.
scripts/l11-mall.js - Level 11 strip-mall shell and shallow cloth awning geometry, parameterized by kind and dimensions.

scripts/lib/build-piece.js + scripts/lib/data/breakables.yml + scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml - canonical breakable/material/build specs and furniture models shared by B-mode, harvesting and reconstruction.

scripts/lib/critter-model.js + scripts/lib/data/critter-models.yml + wardrobe*.yml - shared furry and optional human body/face/hair/garment selection, appearance seating/restyle, legacy migration, and player/NPC presentation.
notableExports: scripts/lib/loot.js - POOL, poolOf, rollWeapon, gateItems, rollLock, rollCash, rollItem, spawnCrate and Level 2 container/loot helpers; scripts/lib/weapons.js - baseOf, variantOf, rollVariant, rarityIdx, rarityCap, default.
scripts/grab.js - setDown, onInput, update, looseSpent; scripts/kick.js - onInput, kickSnap, kickEnd, update.
scripts/player.js - maxHp, maxSan, xpNeed, weaponOf, gain, takeToken, useSnack, onInput, hitTarget, fishNibble, HOLO and holoEnd; throwable fuse/arm callbacks and blast hits.
scripts/lib/quick-items.js - quickItems, assignQuick; scripts/lib/screen.js - WRIST, screen, canOpen, openWrist; scripts/routing.js - pickRoom.

scripts/critter.js - update, onInput and face/blink handlers; scripts/lib/critter-model.js - setStyle, HUMAN, STYLE_V (sw146), body/face/head/spec, hair/wardrobe seating, restyle/clearAppearance, humanBodyMorph, speciesOf, anime, FURRY_HEAD.
scripts/lib/body3.js - heldRot, famOf, play, tick3, swing3, fire3, handle3, react3, stagger3, aimPose, aimMode, longHands, stance; scripts/lib/vmpose.js - VM_FOV, poseViewmodel.
scripts/lib/craft.js - recipeStatus, maxMakes, craftOne, benchAvailable, stationOf, scrapCount, CRAFT_LIMIT, CATS; scripts/craft.js - onInput, update.

scripts/lib/prop-interactions.js - propKind, interactiveSpec, upgradeProp, containerPose, toggleLamp, upgradeNearby; scripts/lib/prop-easing.js - MOTION_MS, sampleMotion, propFrames; scripts/l11-masonry.js - geometry, collider.
ownership: scripts/player.js - persistent player.state progression, health/sanity, inventory/equipment/ammo, needs, money, appearance, combat/rewards, level access, saved place/position, wakeAtSave restoration, heat/cold, and carried tapes/playback.

scripts/lib/dina-quest.js - dinaQ, dinaDiary and dcut, and seeds player.state.quests['the-way-back']; scripts/lib/quests.js owns player.state.quests, qtrack and qdone; level quest handlers own their per-player quest fields.
scripts/kick.js + scripts/grab.js - per-player kick rolls/cooldowns, carried prop/body IDs, held-body grip, drag/heave/throw session fields and carryMul; held targets own heldBy/down/stagger state.

scripts/lib/loose.js + scripts/lib/breakables.js - loose props own state.loose/mat/hp and flight sessions; breakables own wreck transitions and permanently smashed root IDs in place.state.gone; both guard Bonus.
scripts/lib/knock.js + scripts/lib/stats.js - foe attributes/weight and shared down/stagger knock outcomes; enemy managers retain AI state and write player-targeting sneakTarget.
places/level1/sim.js, places/level2/sim.js, places/level4/sim.js and places/level27/sim.js own their place-state migration/version markers and one-time conversions (officeV, islandSplit in Level 4).

scripts/lib/prop-interactions.js and scripts/prop-part.js - prop state owns interactiveV, propArt, containerOpen/lampOn and part motion goals; child sessions track native tween keys, while prop parts animate from replicated state.

scripts/critter.js + scripts/main-menu.js - player.state.look and player.bodyStyle; main-menu's BODIES selection also writes world.state.bodyStyle, which controls the avatar style used by NPCs in that world.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered behaviors for locomotion, player/foe steps, swim/climb, interact/grab/kick/rest/mahjong/talk/build/noclip/stats/craft/OS/lockpick/fights/horde/critter/menu/hub/view3/quest markers.
world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → third-person camera; camera writes aimPt and ranged aimPitch → player.js ballistics.

scripts/routing.js accepts permitted requested rooms; otherwise scripts/lib/hub.js soloRoom selects the player's solo Backrooms room and bonus overflow IDs; toHub/toSolo perform crossings and track roomHop/save-place state.

Fresh visit → scripts/main-menu.js; START enters intake for creation or bonus for completed characters; wardrobe close runs intro-cut then tutorial0 unless t0Done; menu UI renders on menuOpen and solo pause sets place.timeScale.

Main-menu BODIES action → player.state.bodyStyle and world.state.bodyStyle; scripts/lib/critter-model.js setStyle reads world bodyStyle and selects humans only for 'human', otherwise furry; Bonus sim applies this before NPC updates/re-dress.
scripts/lib/hub.js destinations → hub-ui.js and hub.js crossings; Bonus sim lays NPCs/effects and mall counters write shop/food state consumed by handlers/UI.
Found loot search → scripts/interact.js calls loot.gateItems for non-storage/non-NPC contents; rarity caps are 1-2 common, 3-5 uncommon, 6-9 rare, 10+ elite; weapon variants roll through weapons.js.
interact.js focus → player.state.focus and loot-ui.js prompt only on the play screen; ui-theme/screen hide prompts behind panels; interact.js clears focus outlines in menus/talk/cutscenes/build mode.

interact.js openLoot/closeLoot → prop-interactions.containerPose → child part state.goal; scripts/prop-part.js samples cubic motion and builtin tween animates articulated storage fronts; toggleLamp flips light part goals.

scripts/lib/prop-interactions.js interactiveSpec → generated furniture from scripts/lib/furniture.js and upgradeNearby nearby legacy props; preserves root collider/state and tags; prop-part children provide moving doors/drawers/lids.

Player craft action/UI → scripts/lib/craft.js stationOf + craft.yml; built pieces in breakables.yml carry bench=cook/ammo and state.station; craft.js/craft-ui.js filter station recipes while hand menu lists all recipes.

Player bodyStyle/look → scripts/critter.js and critter-model.js build selected body and skin-attached hair/wardrobe; Bonus and authored NPC looks reuse the same avatar specification and seating pipeline.
behaviorFamilies: places/bonus/cells/x0z0.scene + scripts/lib/data/bonus.yml + places/bonus/sim.js + scripts/lib/bonus-extra.js + mall-shopper.js/salon-stylist.js/salon-ui.js - authored mall, simulated mall life, salon and one-time neon/fountain lighting effects.
scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + scripts/lib/build-piece.js + scripts/build.js + home reconstruction scripts - per-piece models/dimensions with common placement, persistence and rebuild path.

scripts/door-geo.js + scripts/lib/door-swing.js and scripts/lib/prop-interactions.js + interactive-props.yml + prop-part.js - parametric/eased doors and authored animated storage parts, fitted to supported kinds and migrated while preserving root state.
places/level01/sim.js + scripts/zenith-geo.js + scripts/zenith-breach-geo.js + Zenith door/bots/hatch/flicker/drones/use scripts - Zenith Station geometry, breach, hazards and interactive systems.
places/level4/cells/x0z0.scene + places/level4/sim.js + scripts/l4-office.js/l4-office-geo.js/l4-home.js + Level 4/5 people data - authored office/hotel, props, fixtures, residents and hazards.

scripts/lib/critter-model.js + scripts/lib/data/critter-models.yml + wardrobe-split.yml + ward-slots.yml + critter/faces/hair/model data + art/human-cloth/body/rig/transfer/body-shape and art/human-body - shared critter default and optional split-skinned human avatar families; runtime style set by world.bodyStyle, STYLE_V sw146.

art/nv-melee/retarget.py + smooth.py + scripts/lib/data/nv-swings.js + scripts/lib/vmpose.js + scripts/lib/data/combat-anims.yml - retargeted first-person and DS third-person melee families select strikes by weapon type; combat poses are shared across weapons.

Level 11 geometry family: scripts/l11-mall.js, scripts/l11-masonry.js and scripts/l11-reno.js parameterize mall, canal bridge/quay/guard and renovation-office pieces; tests/level11-reference.test.js checks bridge clearance and rebuild fit.
probableOrphans: scripts/balloon26-geo.js - exports procedural balloon geometry/skeleton/collider but Level 26 scene placements and barrage use uploaded models instead.
scripts/hairtest-rig.js - header marks it as a temporary hair lane test rig; no tree/package references found.
migrationNotes: Human avatar STYLE_V is sw146: furry is the default again; human NPCs restyle to critters, while human bodies remain selectable. The male body was reshaped and all 77 male garments refit via art/body-shape/run3.sh.

The male human body and matching split body in scripts/lib/data/critter-models.yml and wardrobe-split.yml use /cdn/value.ffa88b12900006be2f285f876caccb1174e0519858a6ba51e529ac8a6d360180.glb; update both references when replacing it.
Human avatars use split skinned wardrobe children and a separate Skin_collar region for neckline skin; preserve body/garment material-slot and skin-coverage compatibility when rebuilding assets.

scripts/lib/data/critter-models.yml registers bodies; wardrobe-split.yml maps each sex's body and garment GLBs; ward-slots.yml assigns each GLB's material slots. Keep all three aligned when regenerating or replacing split assets.
The plain inner tee is a separate skinned child for open-front tops; wardrobe-split.yml inner and ward-slots.yml must continue pointing to its cloth_top asset.

Male Ward_jeans and Ward_jeans_tuck remain split at the leg midline with separate rebuilt inner panels; boots select the tucked variant ending inside the shaft. Preserve cloth_bottom/button slot alignment in ward-slots.yml.
